verdict.rationale: Crawl4AI ships a Dockerized FastAPI server, so a downloadable API spec is a fair question for this product. However, no evidence documents a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec, and the probe found every candidate OpenAPI/Swagger path on the docs site returning 404. The interactive playground and MCP integration are adjacent features and do not count as a machine-readable spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
